idea-plugin.name: AI Relay
idea-plugin.description:
AI Relay — Claude, Gemini and Copilot as coding agents in your IDE

One chat panel, three agents, over the whole project: Claude through the Claude Code CLI you are already signed in to, Gemini through the Gemini API, Vertex AI or an Apigee gateway, and Microsoft Copilot through your own signed-in web session. Pick the agent from a dropdown; everything else is the same.

Highlights

  • Agents, not autocomplete — they read, search, edit and run commands across the project
  • Streaming transcript with live tool activity and expandable output
  • Permissions — confirm each tool, accept edits automatically, or let it run
  • Editor-aware — include the current selection with one checkbox
  • Web access and Maven Central lookups so answers about versions are checked, not guessed
  • MCP servers in the same mcpServers file shape as Claude Desktop
  • Nothing to install — the agent runtime is bundled and runs on the IDE's own Java

This is the IDE front-end of the AI Relay command-line tool; the two share their configuration in ~/.airelay.

☕ Free and open source (MIT). Source, issues, and contributions: github.com/Chelayel/ai-relay.

Independent and unofficial — not affiliated with Anthropic, Google or Microsoft.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.8.1 — Gemini is the default agent. A change of agent or mode from the panel is saved at once, and the panel follows a change made on the settings page.

1.8.0 — The agent picker is a dropdown again, beside the model picker. On an Apigee gateway the model picker offers only the configured model.

1.7.0 — Slash commands, @file and #skill autocomplete in the composer; queued messages and draft memory; grouped tool calls; open-at-line from diffs and tool rows; Copy and Apply on code fences; permission prompts show the command or edit; a coloured agent switch with a health dot; history search; a setup card for an unconfigured agent; light-theme accents.

1.6.0 — Edits shown as diffs with Revert; earlier conversations listed and resumable; a model picker and, for Claude, a context and cost meter; agent personas from .claude/agents; the mode dropdown no longer restarts the conversation; a clock on the running tool and a summary line per turn.

1.5.0 — Drop files onto the panel or paste an image into the message box: images go to Gemini and Claude as pictures, text files go in with their contents, project-tree drags attach by path.

1.4.0 — A + menu in the composer: attach files, attach a skill (SKILL.md files in .claude/skills and friends), open the MCP config, settings. The panel is coloured by the agent in use, always shows the one actually running, and uses the IDE font. The demo backend is gone from the picker.

1.3.0 — The header shows the workspace folders and the configured MCP servers; the context chip keeps the file name whole and resolves paths against every content root.

1.2.0 — Live editor context: the chip under the message box follows the current file and selection and is attached automatically; click it to leave it out.

1.0.0 — First release: Claude, Gemini and Copilot in one tool window, settings form for every connection, live tool activity, permission prompts, editor selection as context.
